structure/calendar/index.json.advisory: Computed, not celebrated. Every date here is derived from the arithmetic in guidance/liturgy/calendar-computation.md and is a finding aid only. The competent General, territorial, diocesan, religious, parish and church calendar, the approved books and the competent annual Ordo control an actual celebration. Verify against a dated official witness before relying on any date, and never cite this file as an occurrence witness.

territorial.note: Universal Norms 7 assigns these celebrations to a Sunday only where the competent authority has actually so decided. Both forms are emitted; a candidate tagged with one option holds only under that option, and an untagged candidate holds under both. This file does not know which option applies in any place, and a transfer is never inferred from arithmetic.

territorial.note: The accepted Bonn conformed pre-1955 witness's generic Paschal table supplies the usual Thursday assignments. Postconciliar Universal Norms 7 is not authority for this older calendar. A local transfer or external solemnity requires its own competent source; none is inferred from arithmetic.

precedence.note: No general table of precedence is stated in guidance/liturgy/calendar-computation.md, so a date carrying more than one candidate lists them all unranked, temporal candidates before fixed-date ones. The `rank` a candidate carries is the rank its own calendar prints, not a computed ordering, and it does not resolve the day. The competent Ordo decides which mass is said. `appointed` is the one exception, and it states no precedence either: a commemoration is not a rival mass but a text said within the mass of the day, so setting the commemorations aside reads what the index records rather than ordering what it does not. Where more than one mass remains after that, `appointed` is null.

structure/rubrics/index.json.advisory: A finding aid for how a day is put together, and never an authority for what was celebrated. The rules here are transcribed from this repository's own collated publications; the competent particular calendar, a legitimate indult and the competent annual Ordo control an actual celebration. Precedence is one of five decisions, and this layer takes only that one and the orations that follow from it.
